full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media abstract painting hangs on a plain white gallery wall, its surface crowded with black, cream and weathered tan marks. The canvas fills most of the frame and is seen straight on, with a narrow white margin around it and a gray floor band at the bottom. Across the upper left, pale circular and dotted patterns sit beside short black rows. Near the upper right, thick black vertical and horizontal blocks interrupt the lighter field, with rough drips extending down from their edges. The center is a patchwork of narrow bars, clustered dark dabs, scratched pale openings and small round symbols. A dense black cluster anchors the middle lower section, while larger dark blocks sit at the lower left and along the right edge. Warm brown and occasional muted rust fragments appear among the otherwise monochrome layers. Some areas resemble stamped impressions, others rubbed charcoal, dry paint, stitched-looking marks or overpainted paper; none settle into a legible scene. The creamy ground shows abrasion, stains and underlying marks through thin coats. Light is neutral gallery illumination, falling evenly across the canvas so the raised and scraped textures remain visible without dramatic shadow; a soft gray shadow under the artwork separates it from the wall. No reliable words are legible in the marks. The overall composition is dense yet modular, balancing broad black interruptions with many small repeated textures and weathered negative spaces.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介抽象绘画挂在素白画廊墙上，画面表面挤满黑色、奶油白与磨旧的棕褐痕迹。画布几乎占满画幅，正面观看，四周仅留窄白边，下方有一道灰色地面。左上部，浅色圆环与点状纹样靠着一排排短黑痕。右上附近，厚重黑色竖块和横块打断浅底，粗糙滴痕沿边缘向下。中央由窄条、成簇深色点痕、刮开的浅色孔隙和小圆符号拼合。一团密集黑色固定中下部，更大的深色块位于左下和右边。暖棕与偶尔的低调锈色碎片混在近单色层次里。有些区域像盖印，有些像揉擦炭粉、干颜料、仿佛缝线的痕迹或覆盖过的纸，却没有任何部分稳定成可读场景。奶油色底透过薄涂层显出磨蚀、污渍与底下旧痕。中性画廊照明均匀落在画布上，让凸起和刮擦肌理可见而无戏剧阴影；作品下方一道柔灰影把它与墙分开。痕迹中没有可靠可读的词。整体构图密集却有模块感，用宽阔黑色阻断形与许多小型重复肌理、磨旧留白取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: A tactile mixed-media abstraction builds a loose grid from near-black blocks, cream gaps, rubbed gray, ochre stains and occasional rust accents. Dry-brushed passages, stamped clusters, fine dots, scratches and dripping edges accumulate in irregular layers; earlier marks show through later pale scumbles. Some forms are broad and blunt, while others resolve into tiny repeated motifs, creating a shifting scale of texture. Edges are torn, scuffed and partly overpainted rather than cleanly outlined. Even neutral light reveals a shallow relief and porous matte surface, with value contrast carrying the main rhythm. The composition is densely all-over but interrupted by larger dark anchors and breathing spaces, resulting in a weathered, exploratory visual field.
style_prompt_zh: 有触感的混合媒介抽象画用近黑色块、奶油白空隙、揉擦灰色、赭色污渍与偶尔锈色重音建立松散网格。干刷区域、盖印簇群、细点、刮痕与滴流边缘不规则层叠；早先痕迹从后涂的浅色擦层下透出。有些形状宽而钝，另一些则细化成微小重复纹样，使肌理尺度不断变化。边缘撕裂、擦伤并被局部覆盖，而不是整齐勾线。均匀中性光显出浅浮雕感与多孔哑光表面，明度对比承担主要节奏。构图满幅密集，却被较大暗色锚点和透气空隙打断，形成磨旧且探索性的视觉场。
theme_en: A square black-and-cream abstract painting assembled from dense marks and worn surfaces
theme_zh: 由密集痕迹与磨损表面拼成的方形黑白抽象绘画
name: Rashid Johnson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
